releaseNotes:
• Unified Paper Space Presentation Toolbar: Streamlined [Publish ▾] drop-down menu consolidating Page Setup, Vector Blueprint Export, and Print commands into a clean, modern interface.
• Dynamic Page Setup Modal: Instant architectural paper format selection (A4, A3, A2, A1, Arch D) with interactive Landscape/Portrait canvas orientation and custom margin guidelines.
• Architectural Stage & Object Visibility: Complete visibility controls across all 9 design stages with live canvas toggles (H to hide selection, Alt+H to unhide all) and clean layer management.
